title: Align the Vend. Entry-Edit post-modify event with its Cust. Entry-Edit counterpart
summary: The vendor entry-edit codeunit now raises an improved post-modify event that mirrors its customer counterpart, passing both the original and modified entry records for better context to event subscribers.
key_points: New event OnRunOnAfterVendLedgEntryModify added with the same signature as OnRunOnAfterCustLedgEntryModify from the customer counterpart
Old misspelled event OnRunOnAfterVendLedgEntryMofidy obsoleted and guarded with CLEAN29 pattern to maintain backward compatibility
Both event parameters passed by reference to provide full context to subscribers
Change applied uniformly across W1 and all localization layers (APAC, CH, IT, NA, NL, NO, RU)
No behavior changes to end users; change is event-focused for extension developers
quote: The event name is misspelled, and it only exposes the modified entry.
